Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_DM_02021] Reporting failed security access to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service SecurityAccess is received, which re-
sults in a negative response, the DM shall report a security event
SEV_UDS_SECURITY_ACCESS_FAILED to IdsM (see [26] and table
[SWS_DM_02022]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02022].
⌋
[SWS_DM_02022] Security event context data definition: SEV_UDS_SECURITY_
ACCESS_FAILED
